source.description: The raw data from which the grid was built.

label.description:
An informative label representing the source of the data. This is meant to be displayed along with the grid
as its title or caption. Typically an abbreviated value type of the data.

description.description: A more detailed description of the source of the data. Typically the full value type of the data.

cols.description:
The column meta information for this grid. Note that this does _not_ include the label as a column.

@see #labelCol

title:
This data structure presents underlying data as a 2-dimensional array of values with column and row headers.
Its main function is to overlay this structure onto various forms of underlying data for uniform presentation.

Grids can scroll, since the underlying data may be too large to fit in memory. The #size property represents the
_current_ size, and #hasMore indicates whether more rows can be loaded.

@see Data
name: DataGrid
